item.title: Go wild in the country at Vipp’s first US guesthouse
item.description: Vipp Pavilion, designed by the renowned architectural firm Johnston Marklee,is an idyllic retreat in upstate New York

item.title: Nothing Phone (4a) marks an attractive new waypoint on the ascent to peak smartphone
item.description: The new Nothing Phone (4a) is a welcome mid-tier diversion from the relentless quest for the ultimate smartphone. So what, if any, are the compromises?

item.title: Take a photographic journey through Black Country urbanity with artist Tom Hicks
item.description: ‘Black Country Type II’ is a forthcoming monograph from Tom Hicks and the Modernist Society, featuring a bittersweet but celebratory journey through the West Midlands

item.title: From retrofuturist fembots to masculine soul-searchers, life weighs heavily in this London art exhibition
item.description: From mental health to masculinity and belonging, ‘The Weight of Being’ at Two Temple Place traces the emotional textures of everyday life, balancing heaviness and joy

item.title: In the fitting room with this season’s standout looks
item.description: S/S 2026 was an unprecedented season of change and renewal in fashion. Here, we capture the transformative power of its best looks in a fantasy changing room

item.title: This 1960s mobile home in ‘America’s most glamorous trailer park’ went from outdated to adorable
item.description: A dilapidated unit in the bohemian Malibu Beach Trailer Park has been transformed by Alana Marie Interiors into an enviable oceanfront retreat

item.title: A piece of Joseph Eichler’s 1960s vision of Californian suburbia is on the market
item.description: Developed in collaboration with A Quincy Jones and listed at $2.4 million, this home and its neighbours are among Eichler’s final projects, offering a glimpse into the ideals that defined post-war Californian living

item.title: Baz Luhrmann on designing Belmond’s Celia carriage: ‘I take hosting a party very seriously’
item.description: Inspired by ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’ and Jazz Age glamour, the Australian director tells Wallpaper* the story behind his cinematic British Pullman carriage

item.title: Unwrap Hella Jongerius’ fascinating creative universe, as her archives go on view at Vitra Design Museum
item.description: A new exhibition offers insight into the influential designer’s multifaceted practice as she takes a deep dive in a fresh direction, fuelled by anger, joy and experience – she tells us more

item.title: Brutalism – what does the architecture movement mean now?
item.description: As brutalism increasingly influences and dominates contemporary aesthetics, Modernist Estates author Stefi Orazi discusses why we shouldn’t take the movement lightly
